name: Gothic Dark Fantasy Movie
description: This LoRA is crafted to capture the gothic majesty and cinematic drama of dark fantasy. Inspired by legendary fantasy illustrators, it enhances intricate armor, ethereal lighting, and haunting landscapes, blending the raw intensity with mystical elegance. It is a my attempt at creating a cinematic world inspired by Royo , Gerald Brom , Julie Bell and many others artist that I love, but the dataset is 100% synthetic.
